wrong.better: «I'd better not» — «qilmaganim ma'qul» (o'zimga maslahat), taklifni rad etish iborasi emas.

wrong.Both: «Both» dan keyin ko'plik kerak (both suggestions are).
wrong.All: «All» — ikkidan ortiq narsa uchun va ko'plik bilan.

topics.name: Accepting a suggestion
topics.summary: Do'stingiz «Shall we ...? / Why don't we ...?» deb taklif qilsa, rozilikni shu iboralar bilan bildirasiz.

usage.text: That sounds like a great idea. — «Bu ajoyib fikrga o'xshaydi». «sounds like + ot».

example.en: A: Shall we go to the beach? B: That sounds like a great idea.
example.uz: A: Plyajga boramizmi? B: Ajoyib fikr.

usage.text: What a good idea! — «Qanday yaxshi fikr!». Hayajon bilan, oxirida «!».

example.en: A: Let's make a cake for Mum. B: What a good idea!
example.uz: A: Oyimga tort pishiraylik. B: Qanday yaxshi fikr!

usage.text: I like that idea. — «Bu fikr menga yoqadi».

example.en: A: Why don't we cycle there? B: I like that idea.
example.uz: A: U yerga velosipedda boraylikmi? B: Fikr yoqdi.

usage.text: That's a really good plan. — «Bu juda yaxshi reja».

example.en: A: We can leave at 8 and be there by 10. B: That's a really good plan.
example.uz: A: 8 da chiqsak, 10 gacha yetamiz. B: Juda yaxshi reja.

usage.text: Yes. Why not? — «Ha, nega endi yo'q?». Qisqa, oddiy rozilik.

example.en: A: Do you fancy a pizza? B: Yes. Why not?
example.uz: A: Pitsa yeymizmi? B: Ha, nega yo'q?

usage.text: Let's do that. — «Keling, shunday qilamiz». Qarorni yakunlaydi.

example.en: A: We could visit the museum first. B: OK, let's do that.
example.uz: A: Avval muzeyga borsak bo'ladi. B: Mayli, shunday qilamiz.

structure.formula: That sounds like + a/an + sifat + idea

example.en: That sounds like a fun idea.
example.uz: Qiziqarli fikrga o'xshaydi.

example.en: What a great idea!
example.uz: Qanday zo'r fikr!

structure.formula: Yes. Why not? / Let's do that.

example.en: Yes. Why not?
example.uz: Ha, nega yo'q?

topics.tip: «That sounds a great idea» emas — «sounds» dan keyin ot kelsa, «like» shart: «That sounds like a great idea».

topics.name: Declining a suggestion
topics.summary: Taklif yoqmasa, qo'pol «No!» demasdan, muloyim rad etish iboralari ishlatiladi.

usage.text: I'm not sure about that. — «Bunga unchalik ishonchim yo'q». Eng yumshoq rad.

example.en: A: Let's swim in the lake. B: I'm not sure about that. It's cold.
example.uz: A: Ko'lda suzaylik. B: Bilmadim, sovuq.

usage.text: I don't think that's a great idea. — «Menimcha, bu unchalik yaxshi fikr emas».

example.en: A: Shall we walk home? B: I don't think that's a great idea. It's dark.
example.uz: A: Uyga piyoda boramizmi? B: Yaxshi fikr emas, qorong'i.

usage.text: I'm not very keen on that idea. — «Bu fikr menga unchalik yoqmayapti». «keen on» bilan.

example.en: A: Why don't we watch a horror film? B: I'm not very keen on that idea.
example.uz: A: Qo'rqinchli film ko'raylikmi? B: Unchalik yoqmayapti.

usage.text: I'd rather not. — «Yaxshisi, yo'q». Qisqa javob, keyin fe'l kelmaydi.

example.en: A: Do you want to try the spicy soup? B: I'd rather not.
example.uz: A: Achchiq sho'rvani tatib ko'rasanmi? B: Yaxshisi yo'q.

structure.formula: I'm not sure about + that / ot

example.en: I'm not sure about the price.
example.uz: Narxiga ishonchim yo'q.

structure.formula: I'm not very keen on + that idea / V-ing

example.en: I'm not very keen on flying.
example.uz: Uchishni unchalik yoqtirmayman.

example.en: I'd rather not, thanks.
example.uz: Yaxshisi yo'q, rahmat.

topics.tip: Rad etgandan keyin qisqa sabab aytsangiz, gap yanada muloyim chiqadi: «I'd rather not. I'm tired.»

topics.name: Expressing no preference
topics.summary: Ikki taklif ham sizga baribir bo'lsa, shu iboralarni aytasiz.

usage.text: I don't mind. — «Men uchun farqi yo'q».

example.en: A: Pizza or burgers? B: I don't mind.
example.uz: A: Pitsami, burgermi? B: Farqi yo'q.

usage.text: Either suggestion is fine by me. — «Ikkala taklif ham menga ma'qul». «Either» dan keyin birlik ot.

example.en: A: The bus or the train? B: Either suggestion is fine by me.
example.uz: A: Avtobusmi, poyezdmi? B: Ikkalasi ham ma'qul.

usage.text: They're both good ideas. — «Ikkalasi ham yaxshi fikr». «both» — ko'plik.

example.en: A: Cinema or bowling? B: They're both good ideas.
example.uz: A: Kinomi, boulingmi? B: Ikkalasi ham yaxshi fikr.

structure.formula: Either + birlik ot + is fine by me

example.en: Either day is fine by me.
example.uz: Ikkala kun ham menga to'g'ri keladi.

example.en: They're both great ideas.
example.uz: Ikkalasi ham zo'r fikr.

signals.uz: ikkalasidan biri, qaysi biri bo'lsa ham

topics.tip: «Either suggestions are» — xato. «Either» dan keyin birlik: «Either suggestion is fine by me».

mistakes.right: That sounds like a great idea.

mistakes.why: Bu hayajon gapi — oxirida undov belgisi qo'yiladi (yozuvda).

mistakes.wrong: I'm not very keen in that idea.
mistakes.right: I'm not very keen on that idea.
I'd rather not go. / I'd rather not.

mistakes.wrong: Either suggestions are fine by me.
mistakes.right: Either suggestion is fine by me.
